title: Never say earlier work doesn't count
statement: Never tell learners that the hard part is only now beginning or that what they have done so far does not count.
detail: A Grade 3 reading course's published copy rules, distilled from review feedback, include one headed 'Do not demotivate': no line may tell a child that the hard part is only now beginning, or that what they have done so far does not count. It applies to every child-facing string and is checked by judgement, by a person or an agent, not by a validator.

evidence.quote: No line that tells a child the hard part is only now beginning, or that what they have done so far does not count.
Rules distilled from real reviewer feedback that must hold in every lesson.
**Rule.** No line that tells a child the hard part is only now beginning, or that what they have done so far does not count.
**Rule.** No line that tells a child the hard part is only now beginning, or that what they have done so far does not count.
saying 'real work starts' is demotivating for kids who will find the reading and processing of the story tricky in itself.
